name: Tengu Format

unresolved_policy.reason: Tengu has no reference implementation to reproduce (unlike Goat Format), so where a record's chronology cannot place a change relative to 2011-09-17 this format keeps the MODERN implementation rather than assert unproven period behaviour. Where chronology cannot place a change relative to the snapshot, this policy keeps the modern implementation, and the validator surfaces each record (format.erratum-unresolved-defaulted) and reports the 9 cases known to be wrong for lack of a better determinate answer (format.erratum-modern-known-wrong). Records whose chronology IS resolved select their historical version automatically.

notes: period: the September 2011 TCG list took effect 2011-09-01; snapshot is 2011-09-17 (YCS Toronto day 1), the first premier event under the list and the debut of Xyz Monsters in premier TCG competition. chronology: left null until adjacent formats are added. card_pool: materialised from data/releases/ under certified coverage (the card count is pinned in tests/test_tengu_format.py) with period-sanctioned Duel Terminal exclusions and event-only Sneak Peek exclusions. errata: applicability is computed from each record's reviewed chronology against 2011-09-17; the historical implementations substituted are the ones that chronology places in force. Where chronology is ambiguous, unresolved_policy defaults to modern, and the validator names and counts every such default (format.erratum-unresolved-defaulted) and every known-wrong fallback (format.erratum-modern-known-wrong). This note states no count, because counts change with every record edit: run `python -m retroformats report -v` and `python -m retroformats validate` for the current figures. See docs/research/tengu-format-source-gate.md.
